title: New part: Inventory tracking switch is on by default in its own section
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold "Part Library & Inventory - Create & Edit".
custom_steps:
1. Open New Inventory Part.
  2. Find the "Track quantities and cost of goods" toggle and read its default state.
  3. Check for any tooltip, info icon or helper text on it.
  4. Read the section heading and where the toggle, Min and Max sit relative to Average Cost / Sell Price / Core Charge and Tags.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The New Inventory Part dialog has a "Track quantities and cost of goods" toggle defaulting to ON, with no tooltip, no info icon and no helper text.
  • It sits in its own section headed "Inventory tracking", below Average Cost/Sell Price/Core Charge and above Tags (plain-text heading, no box), with Min and Max inside the section under the toggle.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 4 (Create an untracked part); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R1: “The New Inventory Part dialog contains a "Track quantities and cost of goods" toggle, defaulting to ON.”
  • S4-R2: “The toggle has no tooltip, no info icon and no helper text.”
  • S4-R6: “The toggle sits in its own section headed "Inventory tracking", below Average Cost, Sell Price and Core Charge and above Tags. The heading is plain text in the same style as the "Inventory" heading over the bin locations, with no box around the section. Min and Max sit inside the section, under the toggle.”
